x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

Raadsinformatiebrief.title: Raadsinformatiebrief
Raadsinformatiebrief.description: A raadsinformatiebrief (RIB / collegebrief): the college's formal outbound information letter to the council under its actieve informatieplicht (Gemeentewet art. 169), tracked from verzending through optional agendering ter kennisname to betrokken-bij-behandeling, with a per-RIB technische-vragen thread (TechnischeVraag), an optional toezegging-afdoening cross-reference, and WOO-aware public publication via the OpenRegister published-predicate. A RIB is outbound and college-issued: it is explicitly NOT an IngekomenStuk (ingekomen-stukken-register owns inbound external mail) and college-internal drafting/parafering stays out of Decidiq (procest domain); Decidiq registers the sent letter only. CONSTRAINT (design D4): this schema contains ONLY publishable fields by construction (no drafts, no parafen, no addresses, no citizen PII), portefeuillehouders are public officeholders. Adding ANY non-public property requires revisiting the public-predicate design in D4, because the whole live object is exposed through the public-group authorization.read rule when publicationDate <= $now.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-RIB-002). Canonical dialect verbatim from the Toezegging/IngekomenStuk schemas (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'default'). verzonden → geagendeerd → betrokken-bij-behandeling, with agendering optional (direct verzonden → betrokken-bij-behandeling allowed). betrokken-bij-behandeling terminal. Setting geagendeerd SHOULD carry the agendaItem reference recording the ter-kennisname placement. No app-side state machine.

ribRegistered._note: New-RIB notification to the council members of the directed-to governance body (REQ-RIB-008). Declarative created-trigger (ADR-031); gate-18 hard-fails imperative dispatch. Recipients resolve via object-acl (read) + the decidesk-members group, never kind:field on the portefeuillehouder/Person reference (per decidesk-notifications recipient rules). No bespoke notification BackgroundJob.

number.title: Letter number
number.description: Human-readable letter number in the format RIB-{jaar}-{volgnummer} (schema-validated by pattern). Required and unique per year: often assigned by the college's own systems before the letter reaches the griffie, so Decidiq accepts an externally given number rather than force-generating one (design D5). The creation dialog pre-fills the next free volgnummer for the current year; uniqueness is a review/validation concern (OR has no cross-object unique constraint) and the index sorts by number so duplicates are immediately visible.

subject.title: Subject
subject.example: Wachtlijsten jeugdzorg: stand van zaken en maatregelen

portfolioHolder.title: Portefeuillehouder
portfolioHolder.description: Reference to the portefeuillehouder (wethouder / college member) responsible for the letter (schema:Message sender is the college; this records the responsible officeholder). Required. A public officeholder. WOO-conformant to publish (design D4).

category.title: Category
category.description: Letter category driven by a configurable option list: deliberately an open string, NOT a hard enum, so municipalities can extend categories without a schema change (design risk: category free-text fragmentation, mitigated by the creation dialog offering existing values). Required. Seeded values: toezegging-afdoening, actieve-informatieplicht, motie-afdoening.

sentAt.title: Sent date
sentAt.description: Verzenddatum: the date the college sent the letter to the council (schema:Message dateSent). Required.

directedTo.title: Directed to
directedTo.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (council) the letter is directed to (schema:Message recipient). Required. Drives the new-RIB notification recipients.

letterDocument.title: Letter document
letterDocument.description: File reference to the letter PDF in the object's NC Files folder via the existing Files leaf (no new document store). A file reference only; document content is never stored on this object, which keeps the object fully publishable. Required.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Optional file references to bijlagen (attachments) in the object's NC Files folder via the Files leaf. References only; content lives in Files.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Reference to the AgendaItem recording the ter-kennisname placement (typically the lijst-ingekomen-stukken / LIS item or a dedicated RIB list item of a meeting). Set when the lifecycle moves to geagendeerd. Optional.

settledCommitment.title: Settled commitment
settledCommitment.description: Optional reference to a Toezegging this letter afdoet. Afdoening state and log live EXCLUSIVELY on the Toezegging (toezeggingen-register REQ-002); the ToezeggingDetail surfaces linked RIBs as afdoening evidence via a reverse-relation query, and the RIB detail links back. This register copies no afdoening state and creates no second afdoening log.

relatedFile.title: Related dossier
relatedFile.description: Optional reference to an archival dossier (targets the ArchivalDossier planned in records-management-archiving). Nullable: until that change lands it degrades to a plain link (design D6). Tightening it to a hard $ref later is an additive schema-version bump. Declared WITHOUT format:uuid for the same reason: format:uuid plus a relation description with no $ref is a relation-shaped property that ADR-062 rule 7 rejects, and the $ref has no target to point at yet. Restore format:uuid + $ref together in the commit that introduces ArchivalDossier.

relatedDecision.title: Related decision
relatedDecision.description: Optional reference to a related Decision (e.g. a raadsvoorstel/besluit the letter informs about).

relatedMotion.title: Related motion
relatedMotion.description: Optional reference to a Decision of decisionType 'motion' this letter afdoet or reports on. The motion's execution narrative lives on that motion's own log; this register creates no second execution-update log.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Letter status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): verzonden → geagendeerd → betrokken-bij-behandeling, with agendering optional (direct skip allowed). betrokken-bij-behandeling is terminal.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the live RIB is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Publish is an explicit staff action; because the predicate sits on the live object the public list reflects lifecycle changes (agendering/behandeling) without republication (design D4). A confidential RIB is handled by simply never setting this predicate.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the RIB is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.

TechnischeVraag.title: TechnischeVraag
TechnischeVraag.description: A technische vraag: a short informational Q&A entry scoped to one raadsinformatiebrief, a brief question from a council member and the organisation's answer, rendered as a thread on the RIB detail. A technische vraag is explicitly NOT the formal art. 33 schriftelijke-vragen instrument (the planned SchriftelijkeVraag of fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling owns that): it carries NO answer deadlines/termijnbewaking, NO college-workflow states, and NO fractie-quorum machinery, and it is never auto-converted, escalation is a manual re-filing once SchriftelijkeVraag lands. CONSTRAINT (design D4): only publishable fields by construction (council members are public officeholders); an answered question is anonymously readable through the compound published-predicate (publicationDate <= $now AND lifecycle = beantwoord), so an unanswered question is never exposed even if its predicate is set prematurely.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-RIB-004). Canonical dialect (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'default'). gesteld → beantwoord; beantwoord terminal. Deliberately bounded to two states — no deadline/termijn or college-workflow states (REQ-RIB-005 boundary away from the formal art. 33 instrument). No app-side state machine.

rib.title: Raadsinformatiebrief
rib.description: Reference to the Raadsinformatiebrief this question is about (schema:Question aboutMode). Required: a technische vraag cannot exist without a RIB. The RIB detail renders the thread of questions filtered on this reference, in question order (no nested document).

question.title: Question
question.example: Hoe verhoudt de genoemde gemiddelde doorlooptijd zich tot de landelijke norm?

setBy.title: Asked by
setBy.description: Reference to the council member (raadslid) who asked the question. Required. A public officeholder. WOO-conformant to publish (design D4).

politicalGroup.title: Fraction
politicalGroup.description: The asking member's fraction, a plain string until the Fractie schema (fractievoorzitter-fractie-koppeling) lands: a hard reference now would create a blocking dependency on an unlanded change (design D6). Optional.

setOn.title: Asked on
setOn.description: Date the question was asked (schema:Question dateCreated). Required.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: The answer text (schema:Answer text). Optional until answered; recorded when the lifecycle moves to beantwoord.
answer.example: De doorlooptijd ligt 12% boven de landelijke norm; het plan van aanpak voorziet in een reductie naar de norm.

answeredBy.title: Answered by
answeredBy.description: The answering organisational unit (afdeling), a plain string label. NOT a governance Person reference (design D6). Optional.

answeredOn.title: Answered on
answeredOn.description: Date the question was answered. Optional until answered.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Question status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): gesteld → beantwoord. beantwoord is terminal. No states beyond these two (boundary).

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past AND the lifecycle is beantwoord, the answered question is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister compound published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now AND lifecycle = beantwoord). The structural lifecycle condition guarantees a mistakenly set predicate can never expose an unanswered question (design D4). Publish is an explicit staff action offered only on beantwoord questions.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the answered question is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.
